candidate.hypothesis: The v8 development failure shows that evidence retrieval alone is insufficient when a small answer model paraphrases a correct option or violates a task's explicit output contract. Preserving v8 retrieval while applying a deterministic query-constrained answer transducer will convert sufficiently similar model outputs to an exact query-provided option and otherwise leave the answer unchanged, improving exact task success without inspecting gold labels.
candidate.retrieval: Exactly the frozen v8 phrase-aligned, query-sliced, operation-aware shadow retrieval with zero source-recency weight and at most twenty selected units.

answer_transducer.input: query text and treatment model output only
answer_transducer.candidate_options: the frozen v8 bounded literal extractor over query-provided string options
answer_transducer.similarity: maximum token multiset F1 after frozen Unicode normalization
answer_transducer.action: replace the treatment output with the unique highest-scoring complete query option only when both thresholds pass; otherwise retain the original output byte-for-byte

candidate.storage: One atomic scientific-event batch per benchmark context; evaluation-only shadow storage; production index count remains zero.
candidate.production_promotion: No promotion is permitted during development or admission.

development_firewall.allowed: Opened v7/v8 development evidence and units whose frozen manifests label them development.
forbidden: all MemoryAgentBench validation and final units
all MemOps validation and final subjects
reuse of any v7 or v8 context fingerprint in the v9 development gate

terminal_rule: Any failed development or admission gate is retained as failed_experiment_v9 or failed_admission_v9. Thresholds may not be relaxed and opened held-out evidence may never become tuning data.
claim_boundary: Only a full exact-SHA admission pass permits a bounded benchmark claim. SOTA, universal superiority, production promotion, replacement, 100%-pass, and revolutionary claims remain forbidden without separate external evidence.
